_comment: Les 2 Alpes corrections. (1) OSM tags a disused run 'ancienne piste intermédiaire "Bons"' (ancienne = former) NW near Mont-de-Lans; it is not an operational piste and imports as a disconnected island, so remove it. (2) The Venosc village gondola ('Venosc', 991 m -> 1632 m) tops out ~410 m from the resort base with no piste/path tagged from its top station, leaving it a 2-node island. Add a pedestrian-transfer connector from its top (n2296628004) to the Super Venosc gondola base (n13991766869, 1692 m)   so skiers arriving from Venosc can continue up. (3) Mont-de-Lans glacier plateau: open-elevation quantises this area into flat 3379/3275/3268 blobs, which invented a false basin. Cross-checking every plateau node against two independent DEMs (opentopodata eudem25m + srtm30m, which agree with each other to within 4-7 m here) shows n336366315 and n615079377 are ~30 m too HIGH and the NW cluster around Puy Salie 1 is ~14-17 m too high. That reversed two arrows: the plateau really falls to the WEST, but the bad heights made 'Puy Salie 1' point back east/NE and forced routes through a fake ~20 m uphill jog. Correct them to the DEM consensus. The four NW-cluster nodes are snapped to one shared value (3366, the mean of their 3362-3371 DEM readings) because they sit 15-36 m apart on a genuinely flat shelf - giving each its own noisy value would fabricate 14-17% micro-pitches out of DEM noise. Nodes whose two DEMs disagree by more than ~8 m (the 3414 summit blob) are deliberately left alone.
